dialogues.jp:
試験疲れで、今にもぶっ倒れそうな勢い。風呂
にじっくりと浸かった後、ベッドに転がる。
dialogues.en:
The night after exams is always one of rest. After a good
long bath, I crept into bed.
dialogues.text:
The night after exams is always one of rest. After a good
long bath, I crept into bed.

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましをセットしなくていいというのは、実
に素晴らしい。眠りたいときに眠り、起きたい
ときに起きる。
dialogues.en:
Not having to set the alarm clock for once was great. Sleep
when I want to sleep, wake up when I want to wake up.
dialogues.text:
Not having to set the alarm clock for once was great. Sleep
when I want to sleep, wake up when I want to wake up.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそのまま目を｛つむ／瞑｝ると、夢の世界へ旅立った。
dialogues.en:
With that thought, my eyelids slowly closed, as I made a
trip to dreamland.
dialogues.text:
With that thought, my eyelids slowly closed, as I made a
trip to dreamland.

dialogues.jp:
終った。試験の終った今、俺という存在を縛る
｛さいだいのてき／目覚まし時計｝はいなくなった。
dialogues.en:
It's over. Now that exams are done with, the ties that
binded me to the alarm clock had finally been broken.
dialogues.text:
It's over. Now that exams are done with, the ties that
binded me to the alarm clock had finally been broken.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、｛・・・・・・・・／起きたくなるまで｝、眠ることにした。
dialogues.en:
I fell into a sleep in which I could wake up whenever I
wanted.
dialogues.text:
I fell into a sleep in which I could wake up whenever I
wanted.
